class.name: FmodBus
class.brief_description: An FMOD Studio bus for grouped audio mixing and effects.
class.description:
FmodBus represents an FMOD Studio mixing bus. Buses form a hierarchy through which event audio flows; controlling a bus affects all events routed through it.
Obtain a bus reference with [method FmodServer.get_bus]: [codeblock] var music_bus = FmodServer.get_bus("bus:/Music") music_bus.set_volume(0.5) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID of this bus as a string.

method.name: get_mute
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus is muted.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the path of this bus (e.g. [code]"bus:/Music"[/code]).

method.name: get_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the bus is paused.

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Returns the volume multiplier of the bus. [code]1.0[/code] is the volume set in FMOD Studio.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD bus handle is still valid.

method.name: set_mute
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the bus. When muted, no audio passes through this bus.

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Pauses or unpauses the bus. When paused, all audio processing on this bus is suspended.

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Sets the volume multiplier of the bus. [code]1.0[/code] is normal; [code]0.0[/code] is silent.

method.name: stop_all_events
method.description: Stops all events currently routed through this bus. Pass [code]0[/code] ([code]FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_ALLOWFADEOUT[/code]) for a natural fade-out or [code]1[/code] ([code]FMOD_STUDIO_STOP_IMMEDIATE[/code]) to stop instantly.

members.member: Volume multiplier for the bus. [code]1.0[/code] is normal volume.
